evidence: gpt-oss-120b: "# 1. colour the graph" and "# 0 = left, 1 = right"; qwen3-coder: "Since the graph is bipartite (frequency isolation property)"
affordance_in_statement: The antennas can be perfectly partitioned into two distinct frequency bands. ... Destructive interference ... only ever occurs between an antenna in the first band and an antenna in the second band. ... it is guaranteed that such a partition exists
removal_suggestion: Remove the promise that the interference graph is bipartite, and state that the listed interference pairs are unrestricted. The solver must then handle general independent-set instances rather than simply two-coloring the graph; this changes the computational difficulty, because the bipartite promise is intrinsic to the current task.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Two-color the guaranteed bipartite interference graph and construct an independent set from color classes, handling components.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The antennas can be perfectly partitioned into two distinct frequency bands ... it is guaranteed that such a partition exists

common_affordance: The input interference graph is guaranteed to be bipartite, so a two-coloring directly exposes large independent sets.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It aggregates color classes globally instead of making the correct per-connected-component choice of bipartition side, so arbitrary color flips between components can make its selected side too small.
It recognizes the bipartite shortcut but its component/color-class handling does not correctly guarantee the required exact-k construction across all disconnected components.
It also reduces the task to component bipartition sizes, but its resulting component aggregation or exact-size construction is incorrect on some valid disconnected inputs.

recommended_edit: Replace the explicit guarantee of a two-band partition with a statement that interference pairs are unrestricted and may contain odd cycles. This removes the two-coloring shortcut and forces a general independent-set solution.
